case.summary: The evidence does not support fraud on this risk score alert for card C12382-K1, at a fraud probability of 0.05 resting on 2 independent signal(s): step-up authentication was requested and passed, so whoever holds the card also holds the second factor; the transaction is consistent with this card on 3 independent dimensions: it bills to a region the card already uses, uses a product code the card already uses, arrives at the card's normal pace, with no burst around it.
